what_it_is: the realm's first screen, seen from above, painted around the floor and openings in wireframe 1
must_keep: the floor outline, the knot-hole back to the tree, the way on to the course and the vote spot stay exactly where wireframe 1 puts them; paint no props on the piece spots

what_it_is: the realm's guardian owl, the Realm Vote idol, perched on its own stump or stone
must_keep: feet and perch touch the bottom edge, centred; the owl's face in the top half
how_the_game_reuses_it: once per realm, at the vote spot

what_it_is: the nest or hollow where the realm's hat and pet are traded
must_keep: its opening faces the viewer; its base touches the bottom of the canvas

what_it_is: where the realm's quests are left (a stump, a hollow or a stone with notes tucked in); the quest owl perches on it
must_keep: a clear patch kept free of detail: the game writes the quest there
how_the_game_reuses_it: in the start screen and at the course's middle roost

what_it_is: one small thing that dresses the square (a mushroom ring, a mossy stone, a glowing plant)
must_keep: stands on its bottom edge

what_it_is: what the ground and perches are made of, seen from the side
must_keep: seamless on all four edges
how_the_game_reuses_it: fills every ground and perch body

what_it_is: what trunks, cliffs and walls are made of
must_keep: seamless on all four edges
how_the_game_reuses_it: fills every wall and tall block

what_it_is: the end of a long perch (a bough, a ledge, a rooftop rim), its rounded end on the left
anchor: top edge is the walking line
must_keep: top edge level, straight and at the same height as perch-mid's; the open end on the right cut straight

what_it_is: the middle of a long perch
anchor: top edge is the walking line
must_keep: top edge level and straight across the full width; left and right edges join a copy of itself with no seam

what_it_is: a small perch to hop between (a twig, a stone, a lamp top)
anchor: top edge is the walking line
must_keep: top edge level and straight across the full width
how_the_game_reuses_it: placed many times; the main hopping piece

what_it_is: ground rising left to right that owls hop up
anchor: top edge is the walking line
must_keep: top edge one straight rise from the bottom left to the top right; its high end meets perch-mid's top

what_it_is: a column of rising warm air that lifts an owl straight up, like the gust in the middle of the tree
must_keep: soft and see-through so owls show inside it; top and bottom edges join a copy of itself
how_the_game_reuses_it: the main way up, in place of stairs and ladders; repeated up to any height

what_it_is: a sideways gust that carries a gliding owl across a gap
must_keep: see-through streaks running left to right; left and right edges join a copy of itself
how_the_game_reuses_it: repeated to any length; mirrored to blow the other way

what_it_is: the sky behind the course
must_keep: left and right edges join a copy of itself

what_it_is: the far distance, in front of the sky
must_keep: transparent where there is nothing far away; left and right edges join

what_it_is: the middle distance, nearest of the three
must_keep: quieter and darker than the perches so it never looks like one; left and right edges join

what_it_is: the hollow an owl flies through to the next room, out of the start screen and between course rooms
must_keep: the opening is centred and reads at owl height (150 tall)
how_the_game_reuses_it: every room change; the shared barrier covers it when a way is shut

what_it_is: a perch where an owl rests and saves its progress
must_keep: top edge level; the owl lands on it

what_it_is: a lost feather to find off the main path
must_keep: one feather, centred, nothing else in the file
how_the_game_reuses_it: five per course; the game spins and glints it

what_it_is: what sends the owl back to the last roost (thorns, a downdraft, a sticky web)
must_keep: the dangerous part fills the whole canvas edge to edge; left and right edges join

what_it_is: the realm's own special move (a springy moss, a swinging vine, a beam of light)
must_keep: the part an owl touches is centred on top
how_the_game_reuses_it: placed before every gap it solves

what_it_is: the high roost at the end of the course, where the reward is given
must_keep: stands on its bottom edge; the centre left open for the reward

what_it_is: a large thing on the path that tells where you are (a fallen tree, a giant egg, a toppled statue)
must_keep: stands on its bottom edge; not walkable
how_the_game_reuses_it: placed 2 to 4 times, mirrored and resized

what_it_is: a small thing beside the path (a pinecone pile, a mushroom, a pebble stack)
must_keep: stands on its bottom edge

what_it_is: a plant or tuft that softens the edges
must_keep: stands on its bottom edge

what_it_is: the course's secret character, not an owl
must_keep: feet on the bottom edge, centred, facing left

what_it_is: the hat traded at the nest; the quest owl wears it too
must_keep: its bottom edge sits on the owl's head, centred
how_the_game_reuses_it: sold in the shop; worn by the realm's quest owl

what_it_is: the little pet traded at the nest that follows the owl
must_keep: feet on the bottom edge, centred, facing right
how_the_game_reuses_it: the game offers it in 8 colours
